layout.why: The repo is an npm-workspaces monorepo (apps/landing + apps/shop); component trees live at apps/<app>/src/**. Verified against the installed package, not guessed: node_modules/@starci/eslint-canon-fe exports LAYOUTS = ['monorepo','single-app'], and lint-adoption.mjs LAYOUT_GLOBS maps 'monorepo' to [packages/ui/src/**, apps/*/src/**, **/candidate/src/**] - the apps/*/src branch matches this repo exactly. 'single-app' (src/** only) would govern nothing here.
layout.source: @starci/eslint-canon-fe@3.0.2 installed dist: lint-adoption.mjs LAYOUT_GLOBS + README ('monorepo governs shared package and app source trees')

config: eslint.config.mjs mirrors starci-academy-fe/eslint.config.mjs: ignores (.next/node_modules/dist/out/coverage/next-env.d.ts + captures/** + .scannerwork/**), js/recommended + globals.browser, tseslint.configs.recommended, react flat recommended, react-hooks, stylistic block (indent 4 / double quotes / no semi / array-type generic / prop-types off), starciFeConfig({layout:"monorepo"}), jsx-a11y rule list verbatim, lang-file exemption (**/messages/**, **/locale*/**, **/lang/**, **/*.lang.* -> starci-fe/no-second-language-in-source + no-emoji-in-source off), scripts/** + apps/*/*.config.mjs get globals.node. All blocks scoped to APP_GLOBS apps/**/*.{ts,tsx} + types/**/*.{ts,tsx} (ec-be pattern). No storybook block - no stories exist.

notes: eslint pinned to ^9 per brief; @eslint/js pinned to ^9 to match (v10 peerOptional eslint ^10 conflict).

canon-fe installed from LOCAL source (file:../../packages/fe -> .claude/packages/fe v3.1.0, symlinked) per supervisor update - carries the new route-slot-fixed-name rule at error level (49 rules total); react/-hooks/jsx-a11y added because the mirrored config uses them.

afterAutofix.note: 953 mechanical fixes (indent/quotes/semi) auto-fixed across the pre-i18n tree

handFixes.starci-fe/public-component-signature: 11x destructured/zero-param exported components -> `(props: XProps)`; AppNav gained `type AppNavProps = Record<string, never>` + `void props` (starci-academy-fe convention for prop-less components)
handFixes.starci-fe/no-inline-class-name: 31x inline className -> named exports in new colocated `src/components/classNames.ts` per app (plain string exports; cn() cannot be imported there - vendor-primitive-has-named-owner only exempts <folder>/classNames.ts paths with an intermediate dir, and these flat components share one module)
handFixes.starci-fe/no-internal-starci-href: 7x literal `href="/..."` -> expressions over new `src/modules/routes.ts` ROUTES tables (one per app); raw wordmark <a> tags became next/link <Link> - the routed navigation owner
handFixes.starci-fe/no-public-classname-prop + no-: 2x DuckMascot `className` prop removed (className is banned on non-leaf component props, and monorepo-tier-belongs-to-its-side forbids a leaves/ folder inside apps/*); replaced with semantic `size?: number`; call site now `<DuckMascot size={96}>`
handFixes.starci-fe/no-emoji-in-source: 6x emoji `glyph` values dropped from landing catalog.ts (field removed); ProductCard renders the product initial letter, same neutral tile the shop uses
handFixes.starci-fe/require-export-jsdoc: 8x docblocks added: metadata x2, dynamic x1, DuckMascot x2, CurrentUser, OrderLine, Order
handFixes.starci-fe/no-inline-lint-config + fatal: 1x `/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */` removed from ProductTile.tsx (the rule it suppressed is not even in this config); rationale kept as a plain comment
handFixes.starci-fe/route-slot-fixed-name: 8x slot default-export renames in v3-5's new route tree per supervisor instruction ('fix the files, not the rule'): LocaleLayout->Layout (x2), LandingPage/ShopIndexPage/AccountPage/BrowsePage/CartPage/CheckoutPage->Page (x6). Only the identifiers were touched; the files remain v3-5's.

outOfLaneRemaining.note: v3-5 is actively rewriting this tree mid-flight (route tree moved to app/[lang]/, all view components re-authored with next-intl, types/{i18n,messages,theme} created). Three of this lane's early hand-fixes (LandingView, SiteShell, AccountView) were overwritten by their rewrites and are counted here rather than re-fought. Exception per supervisor instruction: the 8 route-slot-fixed-name violations in their [lang]/ slot files were fixed in place (identifier renames only) - that count stays 0. v3-5 has since reformatted their files to canon style (the mechanical 944 are gone); the remaining 40 are structural: inline classNames, destructure-style signatures, missing jsdoc. Lint types/{i18n,messages,theme}/** and their other new files only after they write i18n-ec-fe.done.

filesTouched.autofixedByEslintFix: 953 mechanical fixes across the pre-i18n tree (later partially overwritten by v3-5 rewrites, counted in outOfLaneRemaining)
